subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should experimental `claws add` be allowed to install or reuse process-wide plugins after exact plan-integrity consent, or should shared plugins wait for a separate host-level grant model?
rationale: The implementation intentionally selects an authorization boundary for globally installed executable plugins; code review cannot determine whether per-plan CLI consent is the intended product and security model.

options.title: Accept exact-plan shared consent
options.body: Keep shared plugin install and reuse in this experimental slice, but require current-head live proof for install, reuse, and compensation before merge.

options.title: Defer shared plugins
options.body: Limit this slice to workspace-scoped skills and keep plugin declarations blocked until a separate host-level authorization design lands.

options.title: Require a host-level grant
options.body: Retain plugin support only after adding an explicit shared-host approval surface separate from agent-creation consent.

recommendation.title: Accept exact-plan shared consent
recommendation.body: Keep shared plugin install and reuse in this experimental slice, but require current-head live proof for install, reuse, and compensation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review addresses the specific shared-host resource and authorization boundary this decision resolves.
